item.description: - Claude plan limits no longer ask for your Keychain password every day. Claude Code rewrites its sign-in each time it renews it, which undid "Always Allow"; Dashbar now reads the sign-in the same way Claude Code does, so macOS doesn't ask. Turning the setting on is the only permission it needs
- Fixed: the Dashbar window could be dragged down to almost nothing. It now stops at a size that fits its pages, and a window left tiny opens at that size again

- **The Dashbar window**: the pop-out button or ⌃⌥D now opens Dashbar as a full window, with Overview, Agents, Servers, System, Clean-up and every running workspace in a sidebar. The menu bar panel stays the quick glance - **A page for each workspace**: its uptime, CPU, memory and energy, adding up its dev servers, its agents and everything they started, with its dev servers, agents and the processes behind the numbers. Open it from the sidebar, a workspace card, or the name or chart button in the panel - A filter at the top of the sidebar (⌘K) narrows the workspaces and the page you're on - On macOS 26 and later, the filter fields and the window's buttons use Liquid Glass - The window shows the checked-out git branch for each workspace
